newsitem.title: FRANCE: Wreck of Cypriot freighter found off France.
newsitem.headline: Wreck of Cypriot freighter found off France.

text.p: The wreck of a Cypriot-registered freighter, which disappeared last month with 25 crew, has been found on the seabed off France, French officials said.
The Albion Two, which went missing while carrying a cargo of steel from Antwerp in Belgium to Jamaica, was identified off the coast of Brittany by the French navy using an underwater camera.
The 29,676 dwt vessel apparently broke up and sank rapidly in a storm on February 17, killing all aboard -- the crew did not even manage to send an SOS.
A Danish fishing boat alerted the French authorities after noting an unusual blip on its radar over the wreck.
In London, Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service said earlier on Friday that the hull was broken in several pieces and the vessel's name was seen on the stern of the wreck.
